prompts.litter-v2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied transparent 4 by 4 litter atlas. Keep exactly the same 16 material identities and reading order, the same cell coordinates, square canvas and real transparent alpha background. Improve it into physically usable DIFFUSE ALBEDO. Every patch must fit within the CENTRAL 75 PERCENT of its own cell with fully transparent space all around, no touching the cell borders. The first cell is TRODDEN, FLATTENED horse dung mixed with crushed straw, not round dung balls. Flatten directional illumination and remove all specular highlights, glossy white rim glints, cast shadows and shiny wet effects throughout. In particular mud, slop and tar must have even diffuse flat colour with only very fine material grain; oil is a thin dark brown translucent irregular stain without relief or rainbow sheen. Green glass retains green pigment and shard silhouettes but has NO white reflection strips, no baked reflected sky. Fish scales are dull grey-silver with no white gleam. Leave leaf veins, grain kernels, shell flecks, fine textures and paper fibres sharp. The shader will add lighting, shadows, specularity and relief later. Natural restrained autumn colours for 1873 Antwerp. No text, no grid lines, no background, no checkerboard, no modern rubbish. Keep the image genuinely transparent.
